meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需求模糊或架构不确定，需要先规划再编码。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete development plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan before coding when requirements are unclear or architecture is uncertain.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先当“规划顾问”：在你动手写代码前，它先探索现有代码、只做只读分析，然后只问你无法从代码里找到答案的关键问题；等你明确说“可以”后，它才写出一份完整的、可直接执行的工作计划，最后交给另一个工人去实施。它自己绝不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你在编码前需要规划，且设计上仍有不确定（如范围模糊、架构拿不准、依赖顺序不明），或说出“plan this”“make a plan”“plan mode”等触发词时，Claude会接管进入规划模式。

say.note: Claude会进入规划模式，先探索再出计划。

say.text: 这个范围有点乱，你帮我拆解一下。
say.note: Claude会作为规划顾问，把任务拆成工作计划。

say.text: 用规划模式，把要做的事列成计划。
say.note: Claude会先探索，等批准后写计划。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planning consultant: it does read-only exploration, asks only what code can't answer, then writes one complete executable plan after your approval. It never edits code.
howto.when_en: It activates when you need planning before coding with remaining design uncertainty (e.g., ambiguous scope, architecture choices, dependency order), or when you say trigger phrases like "plan this", "make a plan", "plan mode", etc.

say_en.note: Claude enters planning mode, explores, then drafts a plan.

say_en.text: This scope is messy, help me break it down.
say_en.note: Acts as planner and breaks it into a work plan.

say_en.text: Use plan mode and list out the tasks.
say_en.note: Claude explores first, then writes a plan after approval.
